caption: The drawing features a single blue glass bowl centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The bowl is depicted in a three-quarter view, showing both the side and the top. The surface of the bowl is decorated with a diamond or quilted pattern, which is highlighted with lighter and darker shades of blue to indicate the reflective and translucent qualities of the glass. The rim, base, and contours of the bowl are outlined with darker blue, while softer, gradient blue tones are used to represent the varying thickness of the glass and the effects of light. The artist's signature, "Beverly Chichester," appears in small, black text to the lower right of the bowl.
title: Baptismal Bowl
